purpose: Development-stage test of CT cross-ply frame continuity as a physical seam/sheet-switch signal. Unlike the rejected tangent-fiber-spectrum-v1 appearance descriptor, this experiment asks whether inserting an adjacent-winding CT slab into one half of a local tangent-frame neighborhood creates a detectable discontinuity across the substitution seam.
claim_boundary: A development pass establishes only that the already-implemented cross-ply frame statistic detects frozen adjacent-winding half-slab substitutions more often than it falsely flags the intact w035 seam on these ten development regions. It does not prove arbitrary sheet identity, recto completeness, reconstruction correctness, ink, readability, or Grand Prize eligibility.

rejected_descriptor.interpretation: The aggregate local angular spectrum is dismissed. This new experiment changes the information tested from patch appearance similarity to spatial continuity across a seam; no v1 threshold or descriptor component is tuned or reused.

analyzer.parameter_source: Existing synthetic-tested defaults and 16x16 splice control already merged before this preregistration; no PHerc0139 cross-ply frame output has been inspected.

source.wrong_wrap_coordinate_source: Previously frozen independent-surface-prediction controls only; this experiment reads CT at those already-fixed coordinates.

split.holdout_firewall: No CT sample, frame, slab, or seam metric may be computed for a holdout ID in development. If development passes, the unchanged algorithm and thresholds must be separately frozen before any holdout CT read.
split.development_reuse_disclosure: These ten development regions were already read by rejected descriptor v1. They are deliberately reused for method development. The ten holdout regions remain unread by both descriptor v1 and this experiment.

tangent_frame.convention: Same right-handed centered-difference frame frozen in tangent-fiber-spectrum-v1: column tangent x; normal=cross(x,row); y=cross(normal,x).
tangent_frame.wrong_wrap_basis: Use the frozen target-center frame at the adjacent-winding coordinate; do not estimate a response-dependent wrong-wrap frame.

sampling.sample_grid: For depth d and local v,u, sample center_xyz + u*x_axis + v*y_axis + d*normal.
sampling.bounds_rule: Every requested target and wrong-wrap sample must be inside the exact level-0 CT bounds.
sampling.invalid_policy: A source slab is invalid if any requested sample is out of bounds, any required CT chunk is missing, or nonzero fraction is below 0.95. No replacement center is allowed.

substitutions.target_left_wrong_right: Columns x<32 come from the target slab; columns x>=32 come from the wrong-wrap slab at the same frozen local tangent coordinates.
substitutions.wrong_left_target_right: Columns x<32 come from the wrong-wrap slab; columns x>=32 come from the target slab.
substitutions.rationale: The substitution keeps the local raster, tangent frame, CT preprocessing, and analyzer fixed while changing only physical winding identity on one side. Both directions are scored so a one-sided artifact cannot satisfy the gate.

analyzer.seam_tile_pairs: With a 64x64 slab and 16x16 tiles, score only the four horizontal neighbor pairs (grid_y,1)->(grid_y,2), grid_y=0..3, crossing x=32.
analyzer.delta_rule: Compute frame_distance_degrees for every seam pair whose two tiles have valid recovered frames, whether or not analyze_slab emitted a finding.
analyzer.flagged_rule: A valid seam comparison is flagged when frame delta > 25 degrees, exactly matching the frozen analyzer switch threshold.
analyzer.group_usable_rule: Target and wrong-wrap source slabs are valid; all three analyzed variants are measured; and each variant has at least 3 of the 4 seam comparisons recoverable.
analyzer.group_detection_rule: A variant is seam-positive when at least 2 recoverable seam comparisons are flagged. The intact variant is a false positive when it meets the same rule.

development_gate.holdout_action: Only if every development gate passes may this exact sampling/analyzer/substitution/gate contract be frozen for the untouched ten-region holdout. Failure dismisses cross-ply-seam-v1 without reading holdout.
